output.quote: Le pôle "socio-économique et participatif" viendra compléter les projets immobiliers et d'espaces publics.
output.why: The programme mentions public-space projects but never says they will be greened, planted or unpaved, and the other green words are only descriptions or place names ("réserve naturelle du Zavelenberg", "cité jardin", and "implantation", which means siting buildings, not planting), so it commits to no greening measure.
